svg.title: SVG Image created as FPGA25T_8L_Unrouted-06 _ Actual J4 input + core_AUX power.svg date 2026-09-29T19:08:07

g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: 06 / Actual power entry, core and auxiliary circuits

g.desc: Title: 06 / Actual power entry, core and auxiliary circuits

g.text: Sheet: /06 / Actual J4 input + core/AUX power/

g.desc: Sheet: /06 / Actual J4 input + core/AUX power/

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: The breakout and cable are not yet designed.

g.desc: The breakout and cable are not yet designed.

g.text: Custom wiring: do not use ordinary HDMI equipment.

g.desc: Custom wiring: do not use ordinary HDMI equipment.

g.text: Three TX pairs and one RX pair use 100 nF AC caps on sheet 14.

g.desc: Three TX pairs and one RX pair use 100 nF AC caps on sheet 14.

g.text: VOS/FB sense the local output. Distributed bypass: sheets 8-9. GTP supply proposal: sheet 13.

g.desc: VOS/FB sense the local output. Distributed bypass: sheets 8-9. GTP supply proposal: sheet 13.

g.text: U3 / AUXILIARY + BANK 0: ~1.8032 V BEFORE R122

g.desc: U3 / AUXILIARY + BANK 0: ~1.8032 V BEFORE R122

g.text: Capacitors provide local charge at the input

g.desc: Capacitors provide local charge at the input

g.text: and help reduce fast voltage disturbance.

g.desc: and help reduce fast voltage disturbance.

g.text: Fuse, polarity and surge protection are absent.

g.desc: Fuse, polarity and surge protection are absent.

g.text: Cable current and inrush need qualification.

g.desc: Cable current and inrush need qualification.

g.text: 06 / Custom power input, core and auxiliary supplies

g.desc: 06 / Custom power input, core and auxiliary supplies

g.text: Regulated 12 V supply + 1.8 V JTAG probe.

g.desc: Regulated 12 V supply + 1.8 V JTAG probe.

g.text: A custom breakout combines them into J4.

g.desc: A custom breakout combines them into J4.

g.text: U2 starts first; PG_CORE then enables U3.

g.desc: U2 starts first; PG_CORE then enables U3.

g.text: PG_AUX enables U5 and new GTP regulator U7.

g.desc: PG_AUX enables U5 and new GTP regulator U7.

g.text: R10/R11 pull these PG signals toward 12 V;

g.desc: R10/R11 pull these PG signals toward 12 V;

g.text: do not connect them directly to FPGA I/O.

g.desc: do not connect them directly to FPGA I/O.

g.text: Their voltage drop grows with load current.

g.desc: Their voltage drop grows with load current.

g.text: Verify voltage at the FPGA, not only at U2/U3.

g.desc: Verify voltage at the FPGA, not only at U2/U3.

g.text: C3/C4 bypass VIN. C6 controls the soft-start ramp.

g.desc: C3/C4 bypass VIN. C6 controls the soft-start ramp.

g.text: Pin 19: 12 V IN. Pin 1: 1.8 V reference OUT.

g.desc: Pin 19: 12 V IN. Pin 1: 1.8 V reference OUT.

g.text: U2 / CORE + MEMORY: ~1.0249 V BEFORE R9

g.desc: U2 / CORE + MEMORY: ~1.0249 V BEFORE R9

g.text: L1/C5 smooth the switched output; R1/R2 set its voltage.

g.desc: L1/C5 smooth the switched output; R1/R2 set its voltage.

g.text: C7/C8 bypass VIN. C10 controls the soft-start ramp.

g.desc: C7/C8 bypass VIN. C10 controls the soft-start ramp.

g.text: Read left to right: J4 brings 12 V in; each buck regulator makes a lower-voltage rail for the FPGA.

g.desc: Read left to right: J4 brings 12 V in; each buck regulator makes a lower-voltage rail for the FPGA.

g.text: L2/C9 smooth the output; R3/R4 set its voltage.

g.desc: L2/C9 smooth the output; R3/R4 set its voltage.

g.text: Supply negative + probe ground join board GND.

g.desc: Supply negative + probe ground join board GND.
